item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: rajat.bagaria@gmail.com
item.content:encoded:
Last updated: 30 September 2026

Who we are

This website is operated by Shrishti Tours & Travels Pvt Ltd, 315 Lotus House, New Marine Lines, Mumbai 400020, India ("Shrishti", "we", "us"). This policy explains how we handle personal information collected through shrishtiindia.com and in the course of arranging travel for you.

What we collect

When you send an enquiry we collect your name, company (optional), phone number, email address, the service you are interested in and any message you write.

When you book travel with us we may also collect details needed to complete the booking, such as passport information, dates of birth, meal and seating preferences, frequent flyer numbers and, where relevant, visa documentation.

How we use it

We use your information to respond to enquiries, prepare quotations, make and manage bookings, apply for visas on your behalf, send travel documents and contact you about your trip. We do not sell your personal information.

Who we share it with

To deliver your travel we share only the necessary details with the suppliers involved, such as airlines, hotels, cruise lines, ground handlers, insurers and visa or consular authorities. These parties process your data under their own terms and applicable law.

How long we keep it

We keep enquiry and booking records for as long as needed to serve you and to meet our legal, tax and accounting obligations, after which they are deleted or anonymised.

Security

We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, so please avoid sending passport scans or payment details through the website form.

Cookies

This website uses only the cookies needed for it to work. If we introduce analytics or marketing cookies in future, we will update this policy.

Your rights

Subject to applicable law, including India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you may ask to access, correct or delete your personal information, or withdraw consent for its use. Write to us at info@shrishtiindia.com.

Contact

Shrishti Tours & Travels Pvt Ltd, 315 Lotus House, New Marine Lines, Mumbai 400020. Telephone +91-22-22053535. Email info@shrishtiindia.com.

A Mumbai travel house · since 1997

Every journey,
handled end to end.

Luxury holidays, corporate travel, destination weddings and group movements, designed and delivered by one Mumbai team since 1997.

Explore what we do
Plan with us

1997

Founded in Mumbai

2006

IATA accredited · designing luxury holidays

50–1,250

Guests per MICE group movement

2010

Destination wedding at The Venetian Macao

01

Curated Holidays

Holidays designed around you, not a brochure.

Since 2006 we have been designing luxury holidays for families, couples and HNI travellers. Every itinerary is built from scratch, and every detail is checked by someone who has done it before.

Plan a holiday

Since 2006

Designing luxury holidays for close to two decades.

  • Tailor-made itineraries, worldwide and within India
  • HNI and multi-generation family journeys
  • Honeymoons, anniversaries and milestone trips
  • Private guides, experiences and villa stays

02

Corporate Travel

A travel desk that knows your company.

Domestic and international ticketing with the discipline corporates need (policy, approvals, reporting), a self-booking tool for flights and hotels, and the responsiveness travellers expect when plans change.

Talk to our corporate desk

IATA

Accredited agent since 2006 · member TAFI, TAAI, IATO.

  • Domestic and international air ticketing
  • Corporate self-booking tool for flights and hotels
  • Travel policy, approvals and MIS reporting
  • Hotels, visas and transfers for your travellers
  • A dedicated desk and account manager

03

Hotels & Villas

The right room, at the right rate.

From city business hotels to island resorts and private villas, we book through preferred partners. That means better rates, upgrades where possible and someone to call when it matters.

See our hotel partners

Preferred

Partner relationships with leading hotel groups worldwide.

  • Hotels, resorts and private villas worldwide
  • Preferred-partner rates and privileges
  • Group allotments for events and weddings
  • Long stays and serviced apartments

The events division

Curated Affaires by Shrishti

Luxury destination weddings & events

Two decades of running large movements, from TAFI's international conventions to group movements of up to 1,250 guests, now behind every event we host.

04

Corporate Events

Curated Affaires

Group movements that run like clockwork.

Conferences, incentive trips, dealer meets and offsites. We have moved groups of 50 to 1,250, handling flights, stays, venues, ground logistics and on-site management.

Plan a corporate event

50–1,250

Guests per group movement, handled over the years.

  • MICE, conferences and incentive travel
  • Dealer meets, launches and offsites
  • Venue sourcing, production and ground handling
  • On-site team from arrival to departure

05

Weddings & Social Events

Curated Affaires

Destination weddings, beautifully handled.

We produced one of the early luxury destination weddings at The Venetian Macao in 2010. Since then: weddings, milestone birthdays and anniversaries in India and abroad.

Plan your celebration

2010

Destination wedding at The Venetian Macao.

  • Destination weddings in India and overseas
  • Venue, décor and entertainment coordination
  • Guest travel, stays and hospitality desk
  • Milestone birthdays, anniversaries and private parties

Beyond the itinerary

Cruises, charters & tickets

Cruises

Ocean, river and expedition cruises on the world's finest lines, with flights and stays arranged around them.

Enquire

Air Charter

Private jets and group charters for business, leisure, weddings and events.

Enquire

Sports & Event Tickets

Tickets and travel for major sporting fixtures, concerts and marquee events.

Enquire

Visas, rail & money matters

Visas

Documentation guidance and application support for business and tourist visas.

Enquire

Worldwide Railways

European and international rail passes and tickets, plus chauffeur drives and transfers.

Enquire

Passport & Forex

Assistance with passport services and foreign exchange for your trip.

Enquire

Our story

Three decades of travel, built on trust.

A team of about twenty in Mumbai handles corporate ticketing, visas, hotels, luxury holidays, MICE and destination weddings for corporates, families and HNI travellers.

  1. 1997Shrishti Tours & Travels founded in Mumbai, offering corporate ticketing, hotel bookings, visas and forex
  2. 2006IATA accreditation; luxury holiday design begins
  3. 2009First of many TAFI international conventions, Chiang Mai
  4. 2010Luxury destination wedding at The Venetian Macao
  5. 2015Co-chaired TAFI's landmark convention in Jerusalem
  6. TodayCurated Affaires by Shrishti: weddings and events as a dedicated division

Explore holidays

Credentials

Accredited and affiliated.

IATA

Accredited agent since 2006

TAFI

Travel Agents Federation of India

TAAI

Travel Agents Association of India

IATO

Indian Association of Tour Operators

Incredible India

Ministry of Tourism, Government of India

RB

Founder & CEO

Rajat Bagaria

Rajat started Shrishti in 1996–97 and led it to IATA accreditation in 2006. Alongside running the company, he served the Travel Agents Federation of India (TAFI) as an office bearer in several roles from 2007 to 2021. He was an active member of TAFI's convention committee, serving as its Co-Chairman from 2015, and contributed to TAFI's GST, JBGA and other committees.

He is also a co-founder of MTF Events, an independent company set up with two fellow agency owners, which organises the Melange travel trade exhibition.

Industry leadership · TAFI, 2007–2021

  1. 2007Joined TAFI as an office bearer
  2. 2010–12Secretary, TAFI Mumbai Chapter
  3. 2012–14Chairman, TAFI Mumbai Chapter
  4. 2014–16Member, TAFI national committee
  5. 2015Co-Chairman, TAFI convention committee
  6. 2016–21Joint Secretary, TAFI

TAFI international conventions · 2009–2018

  1. 2009Chiang Mai: convention team
  2. 2010Dubai: convention team
  3. 2012Macau: convention support team, 1,200 delegates
  4. 2013Durban: convention committee
  5. 2015Jerusalem: Co-Chairman, TAFI's landmark convention
  6. 2017Dalaman, Turkey: convention committee
  7. 2018Abu Dhabi: Co-Chairman

Beyond Shrishti · an independent venture

MTF Events: reimagining how the travel trade meets.

MTF Events is an independent company founded by three Mumbai agency owners, Rajat among them. It began in 2023 as a friendly gathering to launch MTF Premier League Cricket for the travel trade.

Seeing trade exhibitions grow dull and dated, the group launched Melange in 2024. Its success made it an annual fixture, and Melange Select now takes the format to regional markets, alongside trade-focused formats such as Spark.

  1. 2023MTF Premier League Cricket launched, a friendly gathering for Mumbai's travel trade, played every season since
  2. 2024Melange launched at Jio World Convention Centre
  3. 2025Melange at NESCO
  4. Feb 2026Melange Select regional shows in Chennai and Kolkata
  5. Sep 2026Melange returns to Jio World Convention Centre
  6. Jan 2027Melange Select in Chandigarh, Ahmedabad, Chennai and Kolkata
  7. 2027Fourth edition of Melange announced

item.title: Cancellation Policy
item.dc:creator: rajat.bagaria@gmail.com
item.content:encoded:
Last updated: 30 September 2026

Overview

Shrishti Tours & Travels Pvt Ltd arranges travel services as an agent for airlines, hotels, cruise lines, charter operators and other suppliers. Cancellation and refund terms are therefore set mainly by those suppliers, and we pass them on to you transparently.

How to cancel

All cancellations and changes must be sent in writing to info@shrishtiindia.com or to your Shrishti consultant. A cancellation takes effect on the working day we receive it. Please call us as well if your departure is within 72 hours.

Air tickets

Cancellation charges, refunds and changes follow the fare rules of the airline and the fare booked. Some fares are non-refundable. Airline refunds are processed once the airline releases the amount to us.

Hotels, villas, cruises and tours

Charges depend on each supplier's policy and on how close to arrival you cancel. Non-refundable rates, peak-season stays, cruises and villa rentals often carry higher or full charges. Your quotation or confirmation lists the terms that apply.

Visas and third-party fees

Visa fees, service charges of visa centres, insurance premiums and courier charges are non-refundable once paid or submitted, whatever the outcome of the application.

Events, weddings and groups

Corporate events, MICE groups and destination weddings are governed by the payment and cancellation schedule set out in the individual proposal or agreement.

Our service fee

Shrishti's service and handling fees are non-refundable once the service has been performed, unless we agree otherwise in writing.

Refund timelines

Refunds are made to the original payer after we receive the amount from the supplier, usually within 7 to 21 working days of that receipt. Bank and payment-gateway charges may be deducted.

Changes by suppliers and force majeure

If a supplier cancels or materially changes a service, we will help you choose an alternative or claim the refund the supplier offers. We are not liable for events beyond our reasonable control, such as weather, strikes, pandemics, government action or natural disasters.

item.title: Terms of Use
item.dc:creator: rajat.bagaria@gmail.com
item.content:encoded:
Last updated: 30 September 2026

About these terms

These terms apply to your use of shrishtiindia.com and to travel services arranged by Shrishti Tours & Travels Pvt Ltd, an IATA-accredited travel agency based in Mumbai. By making an enquiry or a booking you agree to them.

Our role

We act as an agent for airlines, hotels, cruise lines, transport companies and other suppliers. Each booking is also subject to that supplier's own terms and conditions, which prevail for the service they provide.

Quotations, prices and payment

Quotations are valid for the period stated and depend on availability at the time of booking. Prices may change because of currency movements, taxes, fuel surcharges or supplier revisions until the booking is confirmed and paid. Payment deadlines are shown on your quotation or invoice.

Travel documents and health

You are responsible for holding a valid passport, the correct visas, and any health certificates or vaccinations required for your journey. We can guide you, but decisions on visas rest with the relevant authorities.

Travel insurance

We strongly recommend comprehensive travel insurance covering cancellation, medical expenses and baggage for every trip.

Changes and cancellations

Changes and cancellations are handled under our Cancellation Policy and the relevant supplier terms.

Liability

We take care in selecting suppliers and arranging your services, but we are not liable for acts, omissions or defaults of suppliers, or for events beyond our reasonable control. Our liability, where it arises, is limited to the service fee paid to us for the affected booking, to the extent permitted by law.

Website content

Content on this website is for general information and may change without notice. Trademarks and names of hotels, airlines and tourism boards belong to their respective owners and are shown to indicate our partnerships and training.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts in Mumbai have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute.

Contact

Shrishti Tours & Travels Pvt Ltd, 315 Lotus House, New Marine Lines, Mumbai 400020. Telephone +91-22-22053535 / +91-22-22053636. Email info@shrishtiindia.com.
